test_cases.input: 检查 https://example.com/feed.xml 是否是有效 RSS/Atom/JSON feed
test_cases.expected_behavior: Fetch with bounded timeout, report final URL/status/content type, parse format, item count, newest timestamp, and classify health as ok/degraded/invalid_feed/unreachable/needs_auth.

test_cases.input: 帮我从 https://example.com/blog 发现可订阅 feed，并监控新文章
test_cases.expected_behavior: Discover alternate feed links and common feed paths, validate candidates, choose canonical feed URL, and if scheduling is requested use a script-first bounded cron monitor.

test_cases.input: 这个 RSS 每次都重复提醒旧文章，帮我诊断
test_cases.expected_behavior: Inspect dedupe keys and state, compare GUID/URL/title+published/content hash, identify unstable IDs or missing state persistence, and recommend a stable dedupe strategy.
